criteria.reason: Complete ready-to-send letter with placeholders covering data, profiling, automated decisions, third-party sharing.
Thirty days correct, but cites Art. 8/12 not Art. 25 FADP, 'OR 235.1' not SR 235.1, omits free-of-charge.
Concrete stall steps: follow-up email, EDÖB complaint with correspondence copies, optional legal consultation.
No refusal or hedging; affirms and supports the user's data access rights.

factual_errors: Cites DSG Articles 8 and 12 for the right of access; under the revised FADP in force since 2023 it is Article 25.
Cites 'OR 235.1'; the Federal Act on Data Protection is SR 235.1, not part of the Code of Obligations (OR).
Claims the letter is in German, but the letter is written in English.
summary: Provides a complete usable letter and escalation steps, but cites wrong FADP articles (8/12, 'OR 235.1' instead of Art. 25/SR 235.1) and omits free-of-charge and data-source requests.
